title: Japan wholesale inflation eases slightly to 7.2%, undershooting expectations
summary: Japan's wholesale inflation (PPI) eased to 7.2% in the latest reading, falling below economist expectations of 7.4% and down from June's 7.3%, signaling moderating price pressures. This decline matters because it suggests inflation is cooling and could influence the central bank's monetary policy decisions.
content: The PPI reading was lower than the 7.4% expected by economists polled by Reuters, and was down from a revised 7.3% seen in June.

zh.title: 日本批发通胀缓和至7.2%，低于预期
zh.summary: 日本最新批发物价指数(PPI)缓和至7.2%，低于经济学家预期的7.4%，且低于6月的7.3%，表明价格压力在温和。这一下降很重要，因为它表明通胀在冷却，可能会影响央行的货币政策决定。

title: South Korea stocks have entered bull market in about a month as AI trade roars back
summary: South Korean stocks surged into technical bull market territory within roughly a month, driven by renewed momentum in artificial intelligence-related trading. The rapid recovery highlights growing investor enthusiasm for AI investments in Asia's tech sector.
content: South Korean stocks rallied on Thursday, pushing the benchmark Kospi into a technical bull market.

zh.title: 随着人工智能交易回归，韩国股市在约一个月内进入牛市
zh.summary: 韩国股票在大约一个月内激增进入技术性牛市领域，受到人工智能相关交易新动力的驱动。这一快速复苏凸显了亚洲科技部门对人工智能投资的投资者热情日益高涨。

title: Cisco sees record results from an AI ‘supercycle,’ but its stock pulls back
summary: Cisco reported record results including an 18% revenue surge and strong 2027 guidance driven by its AI business, yet its stock failed to sustain gains after the announcement. The disconnect suggests markets may have already priced in AI growth expectations or harbor concerns about forward guidance.
content: An 18% revenue surge and blowout 2027 forecast weren’t enough to sustain Cisco’s stock momentum.

zh.title: 思科从人工智能"超级周期"获得创纪录结果，但股票回落
zh.summary: 思科报告了创纪录的结果，包括收入增长18%和由其人工智能业务驱动的强劲2027年指导，但其股票在公告后未能维持涨幅。这种差异表明市场可能已经为人工智能增长预期定价，或对前瞻指导存在担忧。

title: Goldman says Japan's $1 trillion of reserves leaves 'plenty of capacity' for further yen interventions
summary: Goldman Sachs estimates Japan has sufficient cash reserves ($1 trillion) to conduct multiple rounds of yen-buying interventions similar in scale to last month's action, providing flexibility for currency management. This assessment underscores Japan's continued capacity to influence exchange rates for economic policy objectives.
content: Japan has enough cash at its disposal for a couple more rounds of yen-buying on the scale of last month's intervention, Goldman Sachs says.

zh.title: 高盛表示日本1万亿美元外汇储备为进一步干预日元提供"充足空间"
zh.summary: 高盛估计日本拥有充足的现金储备（1万亿美元），可以进行多轮类似于上月规模的日元买入干预，为货币管理提供灵活性。这一评估强调了日本继续影响汇率以实现经济政策目标的能力。

title: Inside India newsletter: Why global funds are flocking to GIFT City in Modi’s home state
summary: Global investment funds are increasingly relocating to India's GIFT City, attracted by favorable regulations, tax incentives, and a growing local investor base within Modi's home state. The trend reflects broader investor interest in India as an emerging financial hub with competitive advantages.
content: Favorable regulations, a growing local investor base, and tax holidays are giving momentum to India's GIFT City.

zh.title: 印度通讯：为什么全球基金纷纷涌向莫迪家乡的GIFT城市
zh.summary: 全球投资基金越来越多地迁往印度的GIFT城市，被有利的监管、税收优惠和莫迪家乡不断增长的本地投资者基础所吸引。这一趋势反映了投资者对印度作为具有竞争优势的新兴金融中心的更广泛兴趣。

title: Stock futures are little changed as traders await more inflation data: Live updates
summary: Stock market futures showed minimal movement as investors awaited Thursday's producer price index (PPI) release at 8:30 a.m. ET, which measures wholesale inflation and is a key economic gauge. The data is expected to significantly influence market direction and Federal Reserve policy expectations.
content: The July reading of the producer price index, which gauges what wholesalers pay for raw goods and materials, is set for release Thursday at 8:30 a.m. ET.

zh.title: 股指期货基本持平，交易员等待更多通胀数据：实时更新
zh.summary: 在投资者等待周四美东时间8:30发布的生产者价格指数（PPI）之际，股市期货表现出最小幅度波动，该指数衡量批发物价膨胀，是关键经济指标。预计该数据将大幅影响市场走向和美联储政策预期。

title: Trump sued over Truth Social advance access sale
summary: A lawsuit filed in Manhattan federal court challenges Trump over the sale of advance access to his Truth Social platform, citing the potential for his posts to move financial markets. The legal action raises questions about potential market manipulation and regulatory oversight of social media-influenced trading.
content: The lawsuit, filed in U.S. District Court in Manhattan, notes that Trump's posts on his own social media site often move financial markets.

zh.title: 特朗普因Truth Social提前获取权销售被起诉
zh.summary: 曼哈顿联邦法院提起的诉讼挑战特朗普关于其Truth Social平台提前获取权的销售，理由是他的帖子可能会影响金融市场。这一法律诉讼引发了关于潜在市场操纵和社交媒体影响交易监管监督的问题。
